description: Status bar Cursor token billing with multi-account persistence, combined view, and sql.js auth.
config.title: Cursor Token Usage
config.displayCount: Recent usage rows in details panel
config.statusBarAlignment: Status bar side: left or right
config.statusBarDataSource: Status bar data: current account (default) or overview (all accounts)
config.statusBarFormat: Status bar format: percent, amount, amount_with_reset, amount_with_plan
config.displayFormat: Amount display: remaining, fraction, or compact
config.showTrafficLight: Show traffic-light emoji prefix on status bar
config.showOverLimitToast: Show toast when usage limit is reached
config.alertThreshold.newSession: Alert when new usage requests exceed this count per poll
config.alertThreshold.overallSpending: Alert when included spend increases by this amount ($)
config.alertThreshold.cursorModels: Alert when Cursor Models % increases by this amount
config.alertThreshold.otherModels: Alert when Other Models % increases by this amount
config.alertThreshold.onDemandSpending: Alert when On-Demand spend increases by this amount ($)
config.alertThreshold.totalTokens: Alert when total tokens increase by this amount
config.maxStoredAccounts: Max stored accounts (0 = unlimited; N>0 prunes oldest)
